- Presets: the last question is now “Save this as a preset?”. A preset keeps every answer after the creator (what to make, formats, B-roll, pace), except the notes.
- Next time, right after you pick the creator, “Which preset?” lets you choose one and go straight to the notes. “Change answers” lets you adjust it, and you can update the preset or save a new one at the end.
- Presets are kept per creator. Delete one with the small × on its card.
